title: The fixed ideal of a subgroup of scheme automorphisms
statement: Let $X$ be a separated scheme [def-pc-scheme], [def-weil-proper-morphism], let $G$ be a group acting on $X$ by scheme automorphisms $a_g$, and let $K\leq G$. For each $g\in K$, let $e_g:E_g\to X$ be the equalizer of $a_g$ and $\operatorname{id}_X$. Define the fixed ideal $\mathcal I_K=\sum_{g\in K}\ker(\mathcal O_X\to(e_g)_*\mathcal O_{E_g})$, using the closed-immersion ideal sheaf of [def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf]. The associated closed subscheme $V(\mathcal I_K)$ is denoted $X^K$: this is the scheme-theoretic intersection of these equalizers, retaining their nonreduced structures.

source.place: VI 4.1--4.2, printed pp.76--77 (fixed scheme equalizers and their difference ideals), and VI 4.7--4.8, printed p.79 (the subgroup fixed center).
